content: Nköŋ a Yɛlusàlɛm
Ndam abaal bàfü Yuday, bàlɔɔŋà atɔŋ naa: « Isàkal naa bɛ bàlakyɛy anki asànaa ukaswaŋà un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ, bɛ làkwe anki muwà mɔ̈ɔ̈. »

Yàmɛnà naa an'sye anà mbaaŋ a kölàköl yàkyer abwà uboo a Pɔl anà Banabasi asye anà ba. Ba bàtsül mbar naa Pɔl anà Banabasi anà ndam a baar bumwɛy, bàbeenà Yɛlusàlɛm akà Antööm anà andweer, ntɔn mutsul ndaa ayin.
Wɛɛ akà ba, Ikööŋ kyapɛ indiir byàkäl mfun ntɔn nkyeen aba, ba bàsoonà Fɛnɛsi anà Samàlya, bàmuyisam mbuul a mpem a baar mpa abà Ayudà. Ndaa ayi yàpɛɛ un'sak mbɔɔn akà atɔŋ banswà.
Mpal bàtöl ba Yɛlusàlɛm, Ikööŋ anà Antööm anà andweer bawɛl ba, ba bàsam ndaa yanswà kàkyer Nzam u mbwo anà ba.
Wɛɛ, ndam a Amfarisi amwɛy abà bàbula aklistɔ bàmbarà ntɔn mutɛn naa baar mpa abà Ayudà bàkyer akyɛy anà bàkyer aswaŋ mulab un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ.
Antööm anà andweer bàköŋ ntɔn muler ndaa ayi.

Ungö a mbaaŋ a bwɛlàbwɛl, Petɔlà laa kàmbarà nde, waa kàtɛn naa: « Atɔŋ abaal, bɛ, bɛ làkyàyöb naa sɛmà itaan Nzam kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo abɛ naa u mun amɛ, baar mpa abà Ayudà bàwem Ndaa a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ anà bàsi làkwikilà.
Waa Nzam awà ayöb mpem a baar, katɛɛl imbäl mukapà Dweelà In'kyɛɛl asànaa akà bi.
Nde sye nsöön kàsi anki uboo a bi anà ba: nde kàpöŋ mpem aba ntɔn làkwikilà aba.
Apanà, ntɔn nkye lan'lwab bɛ Nzam, lan'sà bɛ buur u bway a alɔŋki, buur mpa bàkwe bànkaa abi itàkal bi ŋakwo musɛn?
Wɛɛ, ntɔn ngyɛb a Mwol Yɛsu awà ifàsà bi làkwikilà, bi kàwü mɔ̈ɔ̈ sye asànaa ba. »
Abun, un'sɛŋ wanswà kàkäl a kul, ba bàkäl muwem Banabasi anà Pɔl bàkäl mukyäänà ba idiim anà impà byanswà kàkyɛr Nzam akà baar mpa abà Ayudà u mbwo a Antööm.
Mpal bàmay ba mutɛn, Zyak kàwɛl ndaa, waa kàtɛn naa: « Atɔŋ abaal, lan'wem!
Simɔn kàmiyɔɔb naa u nsɛmà Nzam kàkyer aben musɔɔl un'sɛŋ umwɛy uboo a in'sɛŋ myanswà mpa amyà Ayudà ntɔn muwal ikɔb ande.
Ya yan'bwà balàbal asànaa ndaa bàsön aŋangɔɔm naa:
"Mwol kan'tɛn naa: Ungö apan, mɛ in'sàkyer asàyàfurà

content.text: ntɔn musuub ndwà a David ayà yàbü.
Abun, ndam abaal ayisàsal waa isàleŋ Mwol,
anà baar a in'sɛŋ myanswà myàfàtà ikɔb amɛ din.
Ayi ntɛɛn a Mwol afàkyer indiir abi

content: Kyakin mɛ, mɛ in'kasii naa kà ubwaŋ anki mupà mpay akà baar mpa abà Ayudà ban'buul mpem aba akà Nzam,
wɛɛ basöön un'kaan naa ba bàkɔɔn asin tsütsü apà ŋingyäy a itɛk, anà inswem, anà ntsür mpa aŋàtsul kil anà an'kil.
Ntɔn, sɛmà nkööl yàlyaŋ itaan, bye anà baar bàfalɔŋ un'kɔɔn a Mɔsɛ u bul lanswà, ntɔn bàfàtaŋ wa ilä a saba kyanswà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. »
Mbar kàtsül nköŋ a Yɛlusàlɛm

Abun yan'söön ubwaŋ naa Antööm anà andweer anà Ikööŋ kyanswà bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l baar uboo aba anà batöm Antyɔsha mbwo mwɛy anà Pɔl anà Banabasi. Ba bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l Yudɛ awà bàfàbel naa Balàsàbasi anà Silasi, baar bàkäl anà ikɔ̈b uboo a atɔŋ.
Ba bapɛ un'kaan mwɛy awà bàsön ba abà: « Akà bɛ atɔŋ mpa abà Ayudà làfàkal kà Antyↄsha u Siri anà Silisi, Antööm, andweer anà atɔŋ bàmàlapà mbɔr!
Bi kan'wem naa baar amwɛy bàfü uboo a bi, waa bàyàtwaal lingyooma akà bɛ unsà ntɛɛn aba anà bàpɛ mpem abɛ mpay, wɛɛ bi ba katöm anki.
Lalan kàmɛn bi anà kàkyey bi banswà naa yubwaŋ bi isɔ̈ɔ̈l abaal anà bi katöm akà bɛ. Ba bàyà mbwo mwɛy anà nkween abi Banabasi anà Pɔl.
Baar abà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l, bàkyàyälà mɔ̈ɔ̈ aba ntɔn ikɔb a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Abun, bi kàmàlatööm Yude anà Silasi, ba bàyàlakyään u mun aba ndaa nsil ayi.
Yàmɛnà naa yubwaŋ naa Dwelà In'kyɛɛl anà bi ŋakwo, bi kàtsül mukɔɔn akàlatälà buur asin udu a indiir a mfun bi:
utɔn in'twaŋ a ntsür bàfàpà ibɔɔn akà itɛk, anà an'kil, anà ntsür mpa yàŋàtsul kil, anà ipasàsɛ. Bɛ làsàlab ndaa ayi, bɛ lan'kyer ubwaŋ. Làkäl ubwaŋ! »
Apan ba bàkaabà anà Ikööŋ, waa bàtyà Antyɔsha. Akun ba bàtüüb un'sɛŋ a aŋàlàkwikilà, waa bapɛ un'kaan.
Ungö ban'taŋ ba wa, atɔŋ bàmɛn un'sak, ntɔn wa kapɛ ngwal.
Yude anà Silasi, ba ŋakwo sye bàkäl aŋangɔɔm, ba bapɛɛ an'lwɛŋ mbɔɔn ntɔn ba bàwɛl un'kanà anà ngwal.
Ba bàkäl ndam a taaŋ paa, atɔŋ waa bafuur unsà duu akà baar batöm.
Wɛɛ Silasi kàsàsal paa.
Wɛɛ akà Pɔl anà Banabasi, ba bàsàsal u Antyɔsha anà baar asin mbɔɔn mulɔɔŋà anà mukyäänà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Ndaa a Mwol.
Nkaabà a Pɔl anà Banabasi
Ungö a an'taaŋ, Pɔl kàtɛn a Banabasi naa: « Tsweenà bi ifurà mukàler atɔŋ kà an'bul manswà kàyilɔɔŋà bi Ndaa a Mwol, ntɔn muyöb naa ba kwo bà aben. »
Banabasi kàkwen musyen sye anà ba Ywan, awà bàfabeelà sye Malakɔ.
Wɛɛ Pɔl kàmɛn naa kà ubwaŋ anki ba mukyà anà mbuur awà kàsawɛy sɛmà Pamfili anà mpa kàsabay unsà isal aba.
Apan, an'sye màkäl màngwal uboo a ba bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l, undiir awun bàkaabà ba. Banabasi kàwɛl Malakɔ, waa bàbilà anà nde kà an'swà ntɔn mukyà isaŋ a Shipɛlɛ.
Wɛɛ akà Pɔl, nde kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l Silasi, waa kàkyen anà nde, ungö bun'si atɔŋ u kab angway a Mwol.
Nde kàyilyaaŋà u Siri anà Silisi ntɔn muyipà Ikööŋ ngwal.
